cases.name: stale objective writer rejected by compare-and-swap version
illegal jump and success without independent proof are rejected
unknown outcome can only be completed against original operation identity and proof

limitations: Pure in-memory state-machine reference; it does not persist to a database or distributed log.
The state version is a model of compare-and-swap, not proof of a production transaction.
Postcondition proof is a non-empty fixture token; independent cryptographic verification remains unimplemented.
